thread:
Ava: Hey design team — need a small set of launch assets for next week's benchmark webinar. Focus: 1) 3 social motion tiles (low-motion GIFs) that show latency vs cost tradeoffs; 2) a one-slide 'leadflow map' showing inbound routing (webinar signup -> nurture -> sales handoff); 3) a compact speaker one-sheet. Brand compliance pass required. Deadline: Tues EOD. Can you confirm capacity? @Leo @Maria

Leo: Got it. Can you upload the kickoff brief and sample copy? Need dimensions and if we should do native motion or gifs. Also do we have a color-safe alt for dark backgrounds?

Ava: Brief here: https://drive.redwood/marketing/bench-webinar-brief_v2.pdf. Copy for tiles attached in thread. Use native 1080x1080 for socials and 1200x628 for hero. Motion should be subtle (sparkline + token-cost counter). Priya will do compliance sweep.

Maria: I'll scrub copy to 2 variants: concise headlines and long captions. Will paste copy blocks here by EOD.

Sam: Two asks: include UTM templates for webinar vs benchmark page, and a variant where leadflow shows 'Request a Demo' vs 'Book a Meeting'. Also, add a tiny QR tile for live event slides.

Leo: OK. I'll start wireframes. Figma file: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/bench-launch-assets. I'll create components + token counter micro-interaction. Expect first pass Mon AM.

Priya: Compliance: check for competitor comparisons — avoid naming competitors directly in visuals. Also ensure data claims have source lines. I'll review Friday.

figma-bot: New file created by Leo: bench-launch-assets (view link).

Ava: Prioritization: 1) social motion tiles (3 variants), 2) leadflow map (one-slide PNG + editable fig), 3) speaker one-sheet (print/PDF + web JPG). If timeline slips, drop the speaker sheet.

Leo: Noted. Any constraints on animations? Prefer CSS-friendly exports (Lottie ok?) Keep max 2s loop.

Maria: Copy variants: short headlines posted: 1) 'Serve better: lower latency, lower cost' 2) 'Inference that scales affordably' — thoughts?

Ava: :thumbsup: prefer 1 but tweak to 'Serve smarter' maybe. Also include a microcopy line for CTA: 'Save your seat — benchmark webinar, May 16'.

Sam: I'll coordinate UTM params and lead owner mapping. Tagging: source=webinar_bench, medium=social, campaign=bench_may16.

Leo: I'll add a 'brand-flag' layer in Figma for Priya's review and export naming like `bench_tile_v1_social_1080`. Will share PNG and GIF exports in the ops folder.

Ava: Thanks — please @me on the final exports and drop them into /marketing/assets/bench-may16. Let's sync Mon 10am if first pass is ready.
